protocols.evidenceNotes: The source gives two model-only raw rodent transpositions, explicitly not validated human protocols and without allometric scaling: 0.01 mg/kg/day for about 10 days (70 kg arithmetic example 0.70 mg/day), or 0.03 mg/kg/day for 5 days (70 kg arithmetic example 2.10 mg/day). Rodent routes differ. Research only.

schedule.description: Source's raw rodent-dose transposition; approximately 10 days. Not validated or intended as a human dose.

regimen.notes: Source scenario A: 0.01 mg/kg/day for about 10 days. The source also describes a separate 0.03 mg/kg/day for 5 days scenario. These raw rodent transpositions are not allometrically scaled and are not validated human protocols.
